records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the second quarter ended June 30, 2023, the Company generated revenues of $2.09 billion, an increase of 7 percent compared to the first quarter of 2023 and an increase of 21 percent compared to the second quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: New orders booked during the quarter increased 11% and totaled $450 million, representing a book-to-bill of 94 percent when compared to the $477 million of orders shipped from backlog.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of June 30, 2023, backlog for capital equipment orders for Completion & Production Solutions was $1,586 million, a decrease of $15 million from the first quarter of 2023 and an increase of $144 million from the second quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Results reflect improving execution on a higher margin mix of international and offshore projects, partially offset by softening demand for completion equipment and aftermarket services in North America.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Adjusted EBITDA (operating profit excluding depreciation, amortization, gains and losses on sales of fixed assets and, when applicable, Other Items) increased sequentially to $245 million, or 11.7 percent of sales.
